blocks.text: Open to any member of a team in this room (a guest through their personal link) once the room's ballot is in, until the club head finishes the session. All three fields are required; the feedback's score is the engine's average of the first two (8 and 7 make 7.5). No button inside the form — Send feedback in the top bar is its only command. Held by the engine: cab defines the session's feedback form in the engine when the session opens (accuracy and reasoning, whole numbers 1–10, counting in the score; the discussion is the engine comment — required by cab, optional in the engine), sends each team's feedback there and reads it back as the club head, showing each viewer only what the rules allow. Anyone else at this address: the room page.
